title: Complete design with AI
purpose: Produce one complete, provenance-labelled design proposal for the selected experiment using dataset evidence first, relevant scientific Knowledge Base records when found and cautious model inference for remaining gaps.
strategy: One fast bounded request for the selected variant only. LabFlow passes compact experiment evidence plus at most a few useful scientific records, applies safe fill-only suggestions immediately, and leaves only genuinely uncertain values for review.
